Learn & play

Beginner Lessons

New to the game? Our two-hour beginner lessons cover everything you need to sit down and play with confidence:

  • Tile meanings & game setup
  • Basic rules and gameplay
  • Strategies for beginners
  • How to read a Mahjong card
  • Tips for winning hands

Find a lesson at any of our upcoming events — seats are limited!

Open Play

Already play? Bring your skills, make new friends, and enjoy open play at our hosted nights. We supply the tiles, the mats and the good company — you just bring your 2026 National Mahjong League card.

Tiles bring us together. Friendship keeps us coming back.

Our story

About Us

Every game is about more than the tiles — it’s about building friendships, creating memories, and bringing women of all ages and backgrounds together.

Catherine

Catherine lived in Asia for over seven years, where she learned to play Mahjong — and she has played for over 25 years. She is a certified Oh My Mahjong instructor and holds a Master’s degree in education, with NYC, NY State and NJ licenses in K–6 education and special education for PreK–12th grade.

Josie

Josie’s Mahjong story began at home, learning from her Filipino-Chinese mom, Lola — a beautiful tradition passed from one generation to the next. 💗

Different beginnings, same love of the game — and eventually those two stories came together to become Lady Mahjong. 💕
